India-US Hold Talks on Energy Security, Defense Ties

US Secretary of State Antony Blinken met with Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar to discuss energy security and defense relations. During this period, former US President Donald Trump commented on a potential India-US trade deal, stating that both countries were close to reaching an agreement. Separately, Senator Marco Rubio noted an exceptional alignment between India and the US on important issues.
